provenance.head: d4afaf919163c9ada6a844eb72f3780a3c58865e
provenance.series: segmented corpus across source revisions, proved unchanged paths, affected-domain rechecks, and balanced remaining pairs; not one fresh balanced trial

policy.condition: Every source RGB population standard deviation is at most 0.05

plan.selectionHistory: The cutoff was selected after the Crescent moon print-SSIM loss and inspection of the already frozen contrast features. It was not selected on held-out pictures. The 0.32 finder trial did not close the loss; the first requested 65% trial remained internally clamped to 60%. The corrected 65% trial passed 480 reads and gained +0.0133369 phone / +0.00589916 print mean SSIM.
plan.retentionRule: Recheck every completed very-low-contrast Square and three unchanged-domain pixel controls. Other paths keep their prior correction share and all defaults. Measure every key with either mode missing; preserve any duplicate fresh detail observation, with recheck priority fixed before timing.
plan.timing: Segmented series; retain original per-mode observations except predeclared affected rechecks and controls. Keep all superseded rows, cold starts, and interruptions.

postCaptureQualification.scope: All original conditions partitioned across local Node workers after the appearance clock ends. The parent awaits every condition before the next measurement.
postCaptureQualification.implementationProof: The default serial assessment remains unchanged after removing an optional condition-list parameter; the paired clock body is unchanged after removing the scheduler import and provenance entries.

plan.ordinaryRequestFix: The repeated suite caught an oversized request selecting 65% on flat input. The existing regression remains unchanged. Only the exact 65% opt-in and selected source domain now permit that share; oversized requests retain the original 60% cap.

parent.head: 9b7cf7b6fb4fb071b7884af4b1fdb668e95e8348
parent.series: segmented corpus across source revisions: retained unchanged capture paths, isolated affected-path rechecks, and balanced remaining pairs; not one fresh balanced trial

policy.condition: Each RGB channel population standard deviation is at most 0.1 on the browser-decoded source picture

plan.retentionRule: Recheck every completed low-contrast Square, every prior fallback and model-validated row in either shape, every Circle accepted after candidate four, and six predeclared pixel controls. Other accepted capture paths finish before the new Circle mask branch, keep fraction 0.4, and use Original geometry. All fixed payloads stay at version 13 or below, so the new long-code fallback is disjoint.
plan.timing: Segmented corpus across source revisions and merge. Retain original baseline observations for already-measured keys and preserve every duplicate, replaced observation, failure, interruption, and cold start. Not one fresh balanced trial.
plan.protocol: Same frozen ten payloads and source RGBA. Explicit Original crop, default border and eyes, and simpleFallback false; old frozen main ignores unknown options. No reader, condition, threshold, clock boundary, or independent assessment change.

baseProvenance.head: c535bfd624ce31096acd385c1ab1720d502762d3
baseProvenance.series: segmented full corpus: original balanced partial run, balanced continuation, and isolated changed-path Circle detail rechecks; not one fresh balanced trial

plan.retentionRule: Square is outside the new branch. Retained Circle rows use capture validation and finish in their first two candidates; remeasure every other completed Circle row, including all prior fallbacks.
plan.timing: Full-corpus segmented series: original balanced partial run, balanced continuation, and isolated changed-path detail rechecks. Retain cold starts, interruptions, failures, and duplicate main observations; use the original baseline for already-completed main keys.
